# `zk/rsa-test/` — TEST-ONLY fixtures for the RSA escrow credential tool

**Every key in this directory is throwaway test material generated by
`gen-fixtures.sh`. It is not a real identity, protects nothing, and must never
be used outside the automated tests.** Two RSA-2048 keys:

| File | What it is | Used to test |
|---|---|---|
| `signer-key.pem` | signer private key (PKCS#8, unencrypted) | proving, PKCS#8/PKCS#1 parsing |
| `signer-cert.pem` | self-signed X.509 cert of the signer key | certificate parsing (n/e extraction) |
| `signer-pub.asc` | signer public key, OpenPGP v4 armored | PGP public-key parsing, fingerprint |
| `signer-sec.asc` | signer secret key, OpenPGP v4 armored (s2k usage 0 = cleartext) | PGP secret-key parsing, proving |
| `signer-raw.txt` | signer `n=` hex + `e=` line | raw modulus parsing |
| `recipient-key.pem` | recipient private key (PKCS#8) | escrow decrypt / binding completion |
| `recipient-pub.asc` | recipient public key, OpenPGP v4 armored | escrow encryption target |

- PGP packets are hand-packed by `mk-pgp.mjs` (no gpg needed): old-format
  headers (`0x80 | tag<<2 | length-type`), v4 material, s2k usage 0, CRC24
  armor checksum — the same layout real GnuPG transferable keys use.
- The harness (`scripts/test-verify-security.mjs`, Test 47) and the browser
  e2e read these files directly; regenerate with `bash gen-fixtures.sh` if a
  key is ever lost (the tests only require the set to be internally consistent,
  not a specific key).
